name: Workbench P-001 native Windows integration and audio tests
summary: All five remaining Windows Cargo test executables ran natively: 25 passed, 0 failed, 3 pre-existing hardware/audio tests ignored. Four edited integration targets also passed 16 Linux tests. Native CLI checks launched the actual copied PUI executable; manifest checks executed the embedded canonical Python writer. This is test executable evidence, not installed-app acceptance or shipment.

prerequisites.python: Official Python 3.13.9 Windows embeddable package, isolated in run directory
prerequisites.custody: SHA-256 of every copied executable and Python archive verified on the native Windows host before execution

assertions.evidence: Three CLI help/version checks launched actual pui.exe through runtime CARGO_BIN_EXE_pui without a controlling terminal.
Source guards use compile-time snapshots of the tested source, scripts and documentation, without runtime access to the Linux build tree.
Canonical embedded Python writer wrote relative native paths, verified hashes, and passed native Path comparison on Windows.
All six installer tests passed on Linux, including both Unix Bash execution cases.
Native target exits all zero: cli_help3, install_contract4, network_readmodel_contract3, testing_contract4, pui-audio11 passed; audio3 ignored.

rootCause: Integration fixtures coupled native execution to build-host absolute source/binary paths and Unix path spelling. The cross-compilation check could compile these assumptions without exercising them.
recurrenceGuard: Existing maintained Cargo integration tests embed exact source inputs, accept the standard runtime CARGO_BIN_EXE_pui variable, and execute the canonical Python writer with native path comparisons. Unix Bash installer checks remain exercised on Unix.
scopeLimits: Not a release or shipment certificate
Two Unix Bash installer execution tests are Unix-only; all six installer cases passed on Linux
Three existing native audio hardware smokes remain ignored
Previously retained Windows main-target proof is separate and was not replayed
